cli.usage:
Usage:
  yaah [--config <path>]          Start a harness and chat with it in the terminal.
  yaah serve [--config <path>]    Start a harness and serve the A2A API and the web UI.
  yaah tui --url <harness>        Chat in the terminal with a harness that is already running.

Options:
  --config <path>   Use this configuration file instead of ~/.yaah/config.toml.
  -h, --help        Show this help.
  -v, --version     Show the version.
